page.overview:
Who is Muryotaisu Nijimura?

Okuyasu Nijimura (counterpart)|status=Alive|noveldebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 4: Morioh

Muryotaisu appears just like his twin brother. He is tall and has a similar bun like Fukashigi, but it is pointed forward. His initial appearance is a T-shirt, like his brother, and has the number 1068 on it. He later on wears his school uniform throughout the chapters.

Muryotaisu is very loyal to his friends and his brother, and will become extremely violent and aggressive if they are harmed. He is seen motivating Joji so they can stop Kira. He appears to sympathize with other people and tries to protect as many people as possible when the gym was attacked.

Muryotaisu wields a Stand he names Grand Bleu which allows him to summon three dolphins. He names them Enzo, Yohana, and Jacques, and are all able to fly around at very high speeds without worrying about the laws of physics.
